The '''excavated tomb''' was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Burial/Legends|tomb]] built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Athiss/Legends|Athiss]] near the [[Tomb of Vodal Kressh|tomb]] of the [[Sith alchemist/Legends|Sith alchemist]] [[Vodal Kressh]]. Those who had served Kressh during his life remained on Athiss in his tomb and their descendants became known as the [[Tomb Dwellers]]. When [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic survey team six-eight-nine-mark-one|survey team six-eight-nine-mark-one]] landed on Athiss they accidentally discovered the tomb and begun excavating it before they were driven mad and then attacked by the Dwellers. Both the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] then put together strike teams to investigate the area where the survey team had gone missing, and one of the strike teams arrived at the tomb where they [[Mission to Athiss|fought]] the survey team's excavation [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and several of the team itself including [[Professor/Legends|professor]] [[Ley'arsha]].
